body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Xamance, the pioneer in paper management and technology solutions, launched its paper management solution 'Xambox' at the 2009 International Consumer Electronic Show.

Created, designed and developed by Xamance, the Xambox simplifies paper management, allowing users to retrieve documents with just a click of a mouse using the proven theory of 'Chaotic Filing' - finding information without having to file.

Xambox is the solution to the hundreds of hours needed to file and find documents, and untold amounts of money that companies budget to do this. In today's businesses, paper continues to swamp offices in the form of faxes, spreadsheets and emails, resulting in time spent away from work, sifting through documents and clutter. Despite the arrival of digitization, the demand for paper has never been so high and continues to increase. In fact, according to Continental Research, a company with 1,000 employees not equipped with a competitive search tool would lose 250 hours per day looking for information. Xamance's Xambox is the solution to the problem.

The Xambox simplifies the paper-filing process with its integrated solution to managing hardcopy documents. By way of a double-sided scanner with a 50-page feeder, it can sort and store documents of any size, legal to business cards. Capabilities such as optical character recognition and an optimized database for indexing, allow the Xambox to identify documents and classify data. The data are then saved, locally or in a network, allowing document access to numerous users.
